user.title: Configure instance
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the PenguinPVDash server and assign the appropriate energy sensors.

data.output_unit: Unit of the live power sensors
data.verify_server: Test the server connection when saving

data_description.instance_name: A descriptive name for this integration entry, such as “Home PV” or “Test server”.
data_description.server_url: The server address is enough, for example `http://10.10.4.122:8092`. `/api/ingest.php` is added automatically. A complete ingest URL is also accepted.
data_description.api_key: Must match the API key configured on the server for this device ID.
data_description.device_id: Assigns transmitted data to a data source, for example `home` or `home2`. It must match the device ID configured on the server.
data_description.interval: How often Home Assistant sends current values. One minute is recommended.
data_description.output_unit: Select the unit used by the live power sensors below: W or kW.
data_description.verify_server: Checks reachability, device ID and API key without storing a measurement. Disable only while the server is temporarily offline.
data_description.pv_entity: Total current PV output. If several PV systems are present, use a sensor that combines all of them.
data_description.consumption_entity: Total current whole-home consumption. For an additional balcony PV system, select the already calculated total/gross-consumption sensor from Home Assistant.
data_description.feedin_entity: Current power exported to the public grid.
data_description.grid_import_entity: Current power imported from the public grid.
data_description.batt_soc_entity: Current battery state of charge in percent.
data_description.batt_charge_entity: Current power used to charge the battery.
data_description.batt_discharge_entity: Current power delivered by the battery.
data_description.pv_total_kwh_entity: Total PV energy generated today. If several PV systems are present, use a sensor that combines all of them.
data_description.consumption_total_kwh_entity: Total whole-home consumption for the current day. PenguinPVDash does not recalculate this value on the server.
data_description.feedin_total_kwh_entity: Energy exported to the public grid during the current day.
data_description.grid_import_total_kwh_entity: Energy imported from the public grid during the current day.
data_description.batt_in_total_kwh_entity: Energy charged into the battery during the current day.
data_description.batt_out_total_kwh_entity: Energy discharged from the battery during the current day.

abort.connection_successful: Connection successful. PenguinPVDash {version} was reached at {url}; the device ID and API key were accepted.
